This vertical editorial illustration features caricatures of two men in suits and black caps, standing side-by-side against a white background. The man on the left is slender with a tan complexion and closed eyes. The man on the right has a round face, fair skin, and a wide smile. Both men have their hands positioned at waist level, gripping a large green-and-white checkered cloth, or sarong, which spans across the lower half of the frame. 

The top of the illustration contains large green letters, partially obscured, spelling "TEMPO". Smaller black text above reads: "RISAK MAUT DI TANAH DATAR" and "BABAK-BELUR BISNIS KARGO UDARA". Centered over the sarong is the bold black text: "BEREBUT SUARA KAUM SARUNGAN". Below this, smaller black text reads: "PERIHAL CALON PRESIDEN, KIAI NAHDLATUL ULAMA TERBELAH. APA YANG DILAKUKAN KUBU JOKOWI DAN PRABOWO UNTUK MEMBUJUK MEREKA?".

In the bottom left corner, there is a barcode and text indicating: "4-10 MARET 2019", "RP 45.000", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN". A solid red vertical border runs along the far-left edge.
